name: Poison Dart Trap
trigger: Pressure plate or hidden tripwire on floor
fail_effect: Takes 2d10 poison damage and is Poisoned for 1 hour. On fail, the target is wracked with painful tremors.
success_effect: Takes half damage and is not poisoned.
disarm: DC 12 Thieves' Tools to wedge the pressure plate or snip the tripwire safely.

name: Glyph of Warding (Explosive)
trigger: Speaking the incorrect command word or crossing the threshold
fail_effect: Takes 5d8 Fire damage in a 20ft radius sphere centered on the glyph.
disarm: DC 15 Arcana check using Dispel Magic to unravel the magical runes.

name: Collapsing Ceiling
trigger: Pulling a lever or tripping a low cord
fail_effect: Takes 4d10 bludgeoning damage and is pinned under rubble (Prone & Restrained).
success_effect: Takes half damage and escapes being pinned.
disarm: DC 13 Athletics or Thieves' Tools to brace the weak timbers or disable the trip mechanism.
